environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to EC2 on 8080. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application runs as a Docker container with default networking.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules (forward all to target group)
config.security_groups: ALB: inbound 443/0.0.0.0/0; EC2: inbound 8080 from ALB SG only
